settings.heading: Targeted Acne Care & Barrier Formulations
settings.description: High-potency clinical actives, non-comedogenic bases, and lightweight barrier repair—specifically engineered for Indian humidity, UV exposure, and persistent acne.

settings.heading: Engineered to work synergistically. Zero conflicting actives.
settings.description: Most persistent acne in India is exacerbated by compromised skin barriers and heavy, pore-clogging bases. Our clinical regimen follows a strict 4-phase sequence formulated at skin-optimal pH levels to clear active acne, prevent post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH), and fortify barrier lipids.

settings.question: Will these formulations feel heavy or cause sweating in hot, humid Indian weather?
settings.answer: No. Every Project Skin formulation is engineered with lightweight water-gel, fluid, or quick-absorbing emulsions specifically stress-tested in peak Indian humidity. They absorb completely without leaving a greasy residue, film, or suffocating layer on your pores.

settings.question: How soon can I expect to see visible improvement in active breakouts and marks?
settings.answer: Excess sebum secretion and active redness typically calm within 7–14 days. Barrier stabilization and reduced breakout frequency occur within 2–4 weeks. Dark post-acne marks (PIH/PIE) show significant fading over 6–8 weeks with daily application and consistent SPF 50 protection.

settings.question: Can I use Project Skin formulations alongside prescription acne medications (e.g., Tretinoin, Benzoyl Peroxide)?
settings.answer: Yes. Our Calming Moisturiser and Refreshing Cleanser are ideal companions to medical acne therapies, replenishing essential ceramides and preventing the severe peeling, dryness, and stinging often triggered by prescription retinoids.

settings.question: Are all products 100% non-comedogenic and free of added fragrances?
settings.answer: Yes. All products are strictly formulated without pore-clogging waxes, mineral oils, synthetic fragrances, drying alcohols, or essential oils that trigger micro-inflammation in acne-prone skin.

settings.question: What is the Project Skin 30-day money-back guarantee?
settings.answer: We stand behind our clinical evidence. If you do not see visible improvements in your skin within 30 days of consistent use, contact us at support@theprojectskin.com or on WhatsApp for a complete, no-questions-asked refund.
